parsed.name: MC2000电动显微镜载物台控制器
parsed.description: MC2000是一类用于控制显微镜电动载物台或多轴位移台的运动控制设备，通常支持X/Y/Z通道的位置读取、目标位置移动以及摇杆手动控制。在实验室中可用于显微成像时的样品精确定位、扫描和重复定位。
parsed.description_en: The MC2000 is a motion controller for a motorized microscope stage or multi-axis translation stage, typically supporting X/Y/Z position readback, moves to target positions, and joystick-based manual control. In the lab it is used for precise sample positioning, scanning, and reproducible repositioning during microscopy.
